[FACT] User has a meeting next week with a potential client interested in their AI-powered software.  
[EVENT] User needs to prepare a customized demo for the potential client.  
[TEMPORAL] The meeting with the potential client is scheduled for next week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A customized demo can make a huge difference in winning over a potential client.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for creating an effective software demo include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Understand the client's needs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Focus on their pain points.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Keep it concise and focused (30-60 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Script and rehearse the demo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Use real data and scenarios relevant to the client's industry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Show, don't tell; use interactive demos, screenshots, or live examples.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Highlight the benefits of the software.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Use a conversational tone during the demo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Leave time for Q&A.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Follow up with next steps after the demo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Use technology to your advantage, such as screen sharing tools.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Get feedback during or after the demo.
